marker.display_hint: Icon + state changes the plate for work, open, alarm and unavailable states. Icon + state and activity additionally shows a short pulse for events and a continuous pulse for ongoing work, movement or presence. Value + state replaces the icon with one unambiguous HA value. A static icon never reacts to device states.
